label: PUT /customers/{id}
description: PUT /customers/{id}: the id from the route, who the customer now is from the body → the customer; 404 as missing when there is none, 409 as conflict when another customer holds the address, 500 as invariant when who they now are is not a customer this tree keeps (a gold customer without a note), 502 as upstream when the customer API broke. Employees holding the registrar role only: 401 as anonymous without a token or as invalid_credential with a bad one, 403 as forbidden for a customer or an employee without the role.
